items.quote: Excellent customer service and quality work. I recently hired them to do cabinets and countertops in my office, they were on time for each appointment and finished the job in the time they said they would! We highly recommend and we will definitely be using them again! Thank you Brian, Diana and team for your exceptional work ethic, we appreciate the great customer service and quality work. We love our new cabinets!!

Excellent service! We had 2 1/2 bathrooms totally remodeled and love the results! Brian and his team were extremely friendly and honest. The quality of their work was outstanding. Brian had recommendations with color of vanity, countertop, and wall paint which highly complemented the tile and flooring we picked out.

Working with Diana at Decora was a pleasure. All her workers were on time, responsive and did fantastic work. Diana was timely, responsive and amazingly had the project finished in just over a month. The kitchen, laundry room and flooring projects turned out so beautiful and we have received many compliments from friends and family.
